# QUERY-only caller: uniform precision envelope and exact-service boundary

**Result:** an exact source-specific prefix/suffix envelope for the published
3,095-event QUERY-only caller, including every source cut of all 18 calls
to the current 71,144-event native word. Under explicit complete-fibre
unitary, total rounded-primitive and retained compiler contracts, the actual
source fits `F=p+D` and `W=p+h+2D+3` for D>=19, with five extra fractional
bits below 19 and `W+26` integer temporaries. **No new kappa and no physical
rounded caller are claimed.**

The same investigation proves a concrete interface obstruction. Native
MOVE37476 may, under an abstract rounded-child contract, return one grid
quantum on register697. Nothing touches that register before SCALE37480
by `-2/3`, so the existing checked exact service rejects at every grid
precision. This is a contract countermodel, not an observed error of a
retained MOVE implementation, and does not refute the exact-child theorem.

## Verified statements

All bounds below are exact-rational triangle certificates, uniform in the
positive column multiplicity under their complete-fibre operator premises.

| Quantity | Strict bound |
|---|---:|
| Native all-cut mass M_W | 2^237 |
| Native all-cut/final defect coefficients | 2^235 |
| Expanded caller mass M_ctx | 2^355 |
| Expanded caller all-cut defect Sigma_ctx | 2^576 |
| Expanded caller final defect Gamma_ctx | 2^337 |

Forward propagation scans every source cut and pre-ADD product. Separate
backward covector calculations check critical prefix/suffix witnesses. All
helpers remain arbitrary, independent public inputs; the proof keeps their
stage-specific allocation and every owned lifetime.

The current parameters are `v=1920`, ambient153, logarithm power2226 and
`H=14161600000000000000`. Exact integer checks give `4096 K_star<2^H`.
The complete retained path accounting then allows the source constants
above while retaining the wrapper's contribution to admission. The source
has 24-bit scalar numerators, so the old 16-bit premise behind `W+18`
cannot simply be imported.

The optimistic extra-scan model, with all actual port multiplicities, adds
17,165,584 to the previous conditional invoice 826,265,904. Its model total
is 843,431,488, leaving 156,568,512 under the inherited cap. This is an
explicit tariff model; it does not certify literal rounding passes,
historical backing, code/setup constants or the physical recurrence.

## Reproduction

From the repository root:

```bash
python3 -I -B research/query-only-precision-envelope/verify.py --suite all
python3 -I -O -B research/query-only-precision-envelope/verify.py --suite all
```

Expected: `PASS_QUERY_ONLY_PRECISION_ENVELOPES`, `..._GUARDS`,
`..._BOUNDARY`, `..._CONTROLS`, followed by
`AUTHENTICATED_SOURCE_FILES 11`. Standard library only; no Git, network,
subprocess or external solver is used by these commands. `VERIFY.json`
registers bounded normal and optimized suites individually.

`ENVELOPES.json` contains exact rational values and witnesses;
`GUARDS.json` contains threshold/format/model-cost checks;
`BOUNDARY.json` records 35 bounded unchanged-table/executor fixtures
(21 accepts, 14 rejects), including a late-component rejection with no
public writes; `CONTROLS.json` records source and norm counterchecks.
The universal grid obstruction is proved algebraically, not inferred from
these finite fixtures. `PROOF.md` states all premises and limitations.
